name: Extinguish

automation.text: You extinguish all magical and nonmagical flames of your choice in a 60-foot Cube originating from you. Creatures made partially or completely of fire take 1d12 Force damage.

subclasses: Occultist Monster Hunter, Sanguine Thief Rogue, Spellslinger Gunslinger, Arcane Hand Monk, Arcane Hand Monk
description: You extinguish all magical and nonmagical flames of your choice in a 60-foot Cube originating from you. Creatures made partially or completely of fire take 1d12 Force damage.
higherlevels: For each spell slot above 1st that you use to cast this spell, the cube increases by 10 feet and affected creatures take an additional 1d12 Force damage.
